review.reason: 目标是 C UAPI 结构体而非 CLI/协议二进制；BINARY --help、参数规模和 JSON 输出占位符不能触达声明或证明布局变化。

default_user_abi.branch_targeted: 默认用户态 timeval 布局
default_user_abi.expected_output: ABI_CHANGE_DETECTED 且 after_size/after_stride 大于 before 值
default_user_abi.reachability_signal: 同一 abi_probe.c 针对真实 baseline/patched UAPI 头文件编译运行
default_user_abi.setup_required: baseline 与 patched 隔离 worktree；C11 编译器

field_contract.branch_targeted: 新增 compat_reserved 字段的编译期可见性
field_contract.expected_output: baseline field_probe 编译失败，patched field_probe 输出 compat_reserved_offset
field_contract.reachability_signal: offsetof(struct input_event, compat_reserved) 仅由 patched UAPI 成功编译
field_contract.setup_required: baseline 与 patched 隔离 worktree；C11 编译器

time_width_configuration.reachability_signal: 两份头文件均在显式 time64 宏下完成编译并运行
time_width_configuration.setup_required: 支持 _TIME_BITS=64 的 libc 头文件；C11 编译器

runtime_legacy_record_io.branch_targeted: 旧 24 字节记录在 before/after 的 syscall 长度边界
runtime_legacy_record_io.expected_output: before old_write_ret/old_read_ret=24；after 两者均为 -1 且 errno=22
runtime_legacy_record_io.reachability_signal: 两个 guest 均打印 EVDEV_RUNTIME_RESULT 和 success=1；write 经过 uinput，read 经过真实 /dev/input/eventX
runtime_legacy_record_io.setup_required: 隔离 before/after 内核 bzImage、内嵌静态 initramfs、QEMU TCG 或 KVM

runtime_native_control.branch_targeted: 各内核 native record size 的成功 write/read 路径
runtime_native_control.expected_output: before native write/read=24；after native write/read=32；errno 均为 0
runtime_native_control.reachability_signal: native-size 控制路径成功，证明旧记录失败不是 uinput/evdev 环境故障
runtime_native_control.setup_required: 与 I4 共享已构建的双内核 QEMU 环境
